conventions: Shell basis |p> = phi_{I mu}(r) x |sigma> on atom I: phi = (u/r) Y_lm, complex Y_lm (Condon-Shortley), m = -l..l, pure spinors, p = sigma*(2l+1) + (m+l), sigma = 0 the first spinor component of the WFN (s_z = +1/2 along Cartesian z of the cell); one radial function u per shell (the j-average). Lifted four-spinor Psi_p = [phi_p ; (alpha/2) sigma.p phi_p] (the raw kinetic-balance lift of common.bispinor_init), transition current j_pr = Psi_p^+ alpha_vec Psi_r (Dirac alpha matrices). Two-body tensor G[p,q,r,s] = <p(1) q(2)| -alpha_1.alpha_2 / r12 |r(1) s(2)> = -iint j_pr(1).j_qs(2)/r12, Hartree atomic units, WITHOUT the alpha^2 prefactor (alpha = 0.0072973525643); for one radial function the Gaunt and the transverse (Breit) kernels give the same G. Stored per tensor block: N = [N_0 .. N_{2l+1}], N_L = iint_{s<r} u(r)^2 u(s)^2 s^(L-1) / r^(L+2) ds dr, and K = int u^4 / r^2 dr (bohr^-3, normalised u, cubic-spline quadrature in the grid index); psp.onsite_breit.shell_breit_tensor(l, N, K) rebuilds G (W_L[1,1] = -(L-1)(L+2)/2 N_L + (2L+1)/4 K, W_L[1,2] = W_L[2,1] = -3/2 N_L, W_L[2,2] = 2 N_L; G = -sum_L 4 pi/(2L+1) sum_{M,c,t,t'} W_L[t,t'] a^{t,c}_{pr,LM} b^{t',c}_{qs,LM}). Density matrix D[a,b] = <a|rho|b> = sum_n f_n <a|psi_n><psi_n|b> (QE ns is its transpose). Mean field: h_dir[p,r] = alpha^2 sum_qs G[p,q,r,s] D[s,q]; h_x[p,r] = -alpha^2 sum_qs G[p,q,s,r] D[s,q] (Ha). Diagnostics: I0 = N[1] (Marvin), r3 = <r^-3>; b1_mev_per_muB = -(alpha^2/2) I0 in meV, the L.m coefficient of h_dir per unit (N_up - N_dn) of a spherical collinear shell; x_closed_ls_mev = c and x_closed_shift_mev = a in h_x = a 1 + c l.s for D = identity (meV). 1 Ha = 2 Ry, 1 Ry = common.units.RYD_TO_EV eV. projector.chi = r*R(r) on projector.r (bohr), the plain j-average [(l+1) chi_{l+1/2} + l chi_{l-1/2}]/(2l+1) of the UPF PP_CHI functions (psp/hubbard_ops.py::j_averaged_atomic_wfcs), no sign flip, no renormalisation. Generator and theory: psp.onsite_breit_sidecar, docs/dev/onsite_breit.md.
